items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Lawson Seeley's picture on the cover. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I made a recording this last year for a classic jazz label of Sidney's compositions.

ctx.x: Yeah, he did. Ghost of the Blues was one of his really good numbers that was written around 1924.
Lawson Seeley's picture on the cover.

Yeah. I made a recording this last year for a classic jazz label of Sidney's compositions. I picked out, I got a hold of all the music I could from Leeds and Clarence Williams and his various publishers and picked out about 10 of his best things.
